card.name: The word if after "even"
card.fires_on: The word "if" right after "even" in patient-counseling instructions, where the sentence goes on to name a condition such as a rescue drug being given or symptoms improving.

modes.label: Even if, emergency help
modes.description: "even if" in advice to call 911 despite naloxone or an overdose reversal agent being given.
modes.example: Emphasize the importance of calling 911 or getting emergency medical help, even<< if>> an opioid overdose reversal agent is administered.

modes.label: Even if, keep treating
modes.description: "even if" in advice to finish a course of treatment despite improvement.
modes.example: Continue treatment for the full 7 days, even<< if>> there is improvement.
